routing_plan: Primary: route to dedicated pool in us-east-1 (low-latency).
Canary: 5% traffic ramped to new model variant (gptx-8k-q4) for 48 hours, monitor p50/p95/p99 and error rates.
Fallback 1: If p99 latency > 500ms or error rate > 1% for 10m, instant fallback to quantized variant (gptx-8k-q4f) in same region.
Fallback 2: If capacity exhausted or region outage detected, failover to eu-west-1 regional pool (EU data-tagged requests only) with consented residency check.
Rollback: automatic traffic drain with circuit-breaker; SE-run rollback playbook to revert config and restore caching state.
Observability: token-level cost telemetry + trace spans; alerting on cost per-1000 tokens and model degradation (semantic drift evals).
poc_scope: Duration: 2 weeks (pilot), preceded by 3-day smoke test.
Workloads: chat UI (real traffic replay) + embeddings for search (background batch).
Metrics: latency p50/p95/p99, cost per token, error rate, availability, semantic-quality checks on sample prompts.
Goals: validate canary routing, fallback behavior, region failover for EU customers, and cost baseline for committed capacity.
Deliverables: runbook, rollback playbook, cost model, observed dashboards, and recommendation from Redwood Optimize.
